title: Man stabbed to death in front of Brooklyn home
text:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

A 25-year-old man was stabbed to death in Brooklyn on Friday evening, police said.

The victim, identified as Christopher Davey, was attacked around 5:30 p.m. near 882 Albany Avenue in East Flatbush and transported to Kings County Hospital, where he was pronounced dead, according to the NYPD.

Police are searching for two suspects last seen fleeing northbound on Albany Avenue in a black sedan.

One suspect was described as wearing a white tank top and jeans.

No arrests have been made as of Friday evening.

The investigation is ongoing and no additional details were immediately available.
